Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter

Dear Mr. Reddy,

Thank you for meeting us on 15 February 2025 about your dispute with Tanvi More. As we understand it, the couple has a young child. The matter is listed before the Family Court at Vadodara.

Our advice is to agree a joint parenting plan before the second motion. Please collect the school records of the child and the draft parenting plan and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
